page_title: WOL 1-1 EVE | Wolves v Everton 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' That will be all from Nelson Semedo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Santiago Bueno (Wolves).
90+2' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replaces Andre.
90+2' That's the end of the game for James Garner, who is replaced by Ashley Young (Everton).
90+1' Jack Harrison (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Matt Doherty (Wolves) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
88' An attempted cross from Joao Gomes (Wolves) is cleared.
85' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
85' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

84' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Jose Sa guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
84' Jake O'Brien (Everton) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
83' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde will be replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves).

82' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Everton, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
81' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by James Tarkowski (Everton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
81' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolves won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. There is a free kick near the sideline to Everton.
80' Jake O'Brien (Everton) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves will take a free kick near the side line.
79' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) for a tough tackle.
78' James Garner (Everton) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
75' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

74' Matt Doherty (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' Here's the change. Jorgen Strand Larsen leaves the pitch and Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.
72' Excellent touch by Beto (Everton)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.

72' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Jordan Pickford pulls off a brilliant save.
71' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
71' Wolves are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Jack Harrison (Everton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Jordan Pickford comfortably gathers the ball.
66' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
65' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.
64' Stuart Attwell couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Idrissa Gueye (Everton) and blew his whistle. A free kick to Wolves.
63' Here is a change. Jesper Lindstrom is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Tim Iroegbunam (Everton).
63' It will be a substitution. Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) is ready to enter the pitch as Abdoulaye Doucoure walks off.
62' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
60' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
58' The referee blows his whistle as Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Wolves, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
57' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stuart Attwell saw the whole situation. Everton are awarded a free kick.

56' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

54' James Garner (Everton) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
53' Andre (Wolves) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
53' Andre (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Everton have a free kick.

52' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
51' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. That's a free kick to Wolves.
50' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Everton are awarded the free kick.
49' James Garner (Everton) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
48' Jack Harrison (Everton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Joao Gomes (Wolves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' Marshall Munetsi goes off the pitch and Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) comes on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Everton.
42' Joao Gomes (Wolves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

40' 1 - 1 Goal! Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) takes a short pass from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
38' The referee awards a corner and Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) goes over to take it.
37' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Wolves have a free kick.

36' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Jack Harrison (Everton) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Jesper Lindstrom inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
32' Jake O'Brien (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Wolves earn a free kick.
31' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
30' Jack Harrison (Everton) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
26' James Garner (Everton) sends a long ball in, but Jose Sa comfortably gathers the ball.

24' James Garner (Everton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Wolves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jake O'Brien (Everton).
22' A clumsy foul by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Everton.
19' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
17' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
17' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
16' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by James Garner (Everton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' A cross into the box from Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is cleared.
14' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
13' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
13' Jack Harrison (Everton) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
13' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
12' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
12' A pass into the penalty area from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is intercepted by the defence.
12' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
10' The ball is cleared after Nelson Semedo (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
10' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

6' The cross into the penalty area from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
5' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and it's James Tarkowski (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Wolves in a dangerous position.
4' James Garner (Everton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

4' The game is interrupted. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Everton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
2' Beto (Everton) commits a foul and Stuart Attwell immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.
1' The first half has just begun.
Everton will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stuart Attwell.
